message: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW sales_daily without CONCURRENTLY blocks all reads of the view until the refresh finishes.
help: A plain REFRESH takes AccessExclusiveLock on the matview, so every query against it waits for the entire rebuild. REFRESH ... CONCURRENTLY rebuilds it without blocking readers. It requires a UNIQUE index on the matview and cannot run inside a transaction block. If a brief read stall is acceptable (e.g. an off-hours batch refresh), suppress with `-- safemigrate:ignore=refresh-matview-blocks-reads reason="..."`.

lock_impact.note: safe path: REFRESH ... CONCURRENTLY — needs a UNIQUE index on the matview, and can't run inside a transaction block
